Description

Oman’s first satellite. Under the agreement, the project will initially deliver a nanosatellite that will enable groundbreaking scientific research and capture high-resolution images during the lowEarthorbit. The collected data and images, both from the low Earth orbit and deep space missions, will potentially allow for the detection of hidden patterns, identify trends and predict changes caused, for example, by the climate or by natural disasters.
